reasons.action: The request explicitly supplies a performed behavior—the keeper lights the lamp—so action is request-governed rather than inherited from the reference pose.
reasons.medium: Rendering medium is pinned to the reference by the schema; the accepted medium decision preserves the live-action reference and the request gives no rendering-medium instruction.
reasons.wardrobe: No requested clothing or accessory change is present; the observed oilskin coat remains reference-governed.
reasons.lighting: Lighting the lamp explicitly activates an illuminating practical source, so lighting is request-governed; the storm alone is not treated as a lighting instruction.
reasons.framing: No requested shot scale, viewpoint, camera movement, or composition is specified; aspect ratio and the storm setting do not govern framing.
reasons.palette: No explicit color grade, saturation, contrast, or tonal treatment is requested; weather alone does not recolor or regrade the reference palette.
